title: Activating the Annotator: Operationalising Lived Experience in Data Annotation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how annotators' own migration status and a pre-annotation lived-experience elicitation intervention affect their harm ratings, identity resonance, and label entropy when annotating ambiguous hate speech concerning immigration and nativism.

Evaluating how annotators' religious affiliation and a pre-annotation lived-experience elicitation intervention affect their harm ratings, identity resonance, and label entropy when annotating ambiguous hate speech concerning minority religions.

Evaluating how annotators' gender identity and a pre-annotation lived-experience elicitation intervention affect their harm ratings, identity resonance, and label entropy when annotating ambiguous hate speech concerning gender and identity politics.

Evaluating how annotators' sexual orientation and a pre-annotation lived-experience elicitation intervention affect their harm ratings, identity resonance, and label entropy when annotating ambiguous hate speech concerning sexuality.
